title: Touchstone deployment manifest
description: A deployment manifest. Every field listed in `required` is refused when absent — the loader agrees, and the two disagreeing is how a manifest the schema rejects still loads. `max_fee_wei` is required off the local chain, matching the loader's rule that an unbounded fee ceiling is not acceptable on a public network.

network.description: Human label. Never used to choose behaviour — chain_id is the authority.

chain_id.description: Compared against the endpoint's own eth_chainId before signing.

rpc_url.description: HTTPS off the local chain. A path is allowed (X Layer's testnet endpoint ends in /terigon); userinfo, query and fragment are refused because that is where an API key would sit in a committed file.

registry_runtime_bytecode_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the runtime bytecode actually deployed at registry_address. A mismatch means the address holds a different contract than the one this release was tested against.

publisher_address.description: The EVM identity that signs registry writes. Must be authorized onchain and must not be the deployer.

publisher_identity_address.description: The publisher lineage the registry recorded (publisherIdentity). Authorization alone says some owner call let this address publish; lineage says it is the same publishing identity this manifest was written for.

deployer_address.description: Owns the registry. Required: an unstated role address cannot be shown to be separate from the publisher. Never used for runtime signing.

operations_address.description: Funds gas and runs the host. Required, and holds no registry authority; recorded so the publisher can be shown not to be running as it.

confirmations.description: Blocks required before a publication is treated as settled.

deployment_state.description: Whether anything may still be published to this deployment. A superseded deployment cannot be caught by preflight, which compares deployed code against the digest this manifest itself records — so an obsolete manifest agrees with its obsolete registry. Only this field refuses it.

max_fee_wei.description: Refuse to sign above this. A spend ceiling is an owner decision, not a runtime one.

deployment_block.description: Block the registry was deployed in. Event reconciliation scans from here, so a public network is not scanned from genesis.

reporting_keys.description: Ed25519 report-signing keys. Exactly one is active; superseded keys stay listed so existing bundles remain verifiable.

not_after.description: Recorded when a key is superseded or revoked, so its bundles can still be dated.
